would snatch it up in my claws.
These days, though, it tends to hang around—
the soul—
takes its time, malingering in that
dismal, gloomy carcass.
But out it comes in time,
forced by the battling elements
into ignominious retreat.
While I wait, I plague myself with
when, how, and where it will appear.
Death, it seems, has grown a bit weary.
Sometimes it’s actually a question of
will tt or won’ it?
Many a time I've looked down greedily
at limbs grown rigid with rigor mortis;
and what a farce that was!
for the thing began to twitch and stir and rise.

@@U04633@@
(He executes fantastic gestures of conjuration.)

@@U04634@@
Hear me, devils!
Up! Come! Up!
On the double!
You of the straight and
you of the crooked horns!
Devils of ancient stock, tried and true!
Up! Come up!
And with you bring the gaping maw of Hell Mouth!
Hell-of-many-jaws devours its victims
in proper rank and order!
But let’s not stand on precedent,
not even in this final game of parting.

@@U04635@@
(A grotesque Hell Mouth opens on the left.)

@@U04636@@
Already tusks appear, tusks are bared,
the vaulted gullet yawns, spews flames,
a raging sea of fury! And there
translation:
@@U04632@@
会把它抓到我的爪子里。
然而现在，它往往会徘徊——
灵魂——
需要时间，装病
令人沮丧、阴郁的尸体。
但它来得及时，
被战斗元素所迫
陷入可耻的撤退。
当我等待的时候，我困扰着自己
它将何时、如何以及在哪里出现。
死亡，似乎变得有些厌倦了。
有时候这实际上是一个问题
会还是不会？
很多时候我贪婪地往下看
四肢因尸僵而僵硬；
那真是一场闹剧！
因为那东西开始抽搐、搅动、升起。

@@U04633@@
（他做出了奇妙的咒语手势。）

@@U04634@@
听我说，恶魔们！
向上！来！向上！
上双！
正直的你
你这弯角的家伙！
古老的恶魔，久经考验，真实存在！
向上！过来！
并带上地狱之口张开的大嘴！
众口地狱吞噬受害者
按照正确的顺序！
但我们不要拘泥于先例，
即使在这最后的离别游戏中也不行。

@@U04635@@
（一个怪异的地狱之口在左边张开。）
